quick_warnings: Water quality at the main beach can be poor after rains; check local advisories before swimming.
Streets are narrow and mostly unpaved — wear sturdy sandals and watch for puddles in rainy season.
PVR airport is ~45 min away; arrange transfers in advance during peak season.

detail_guide.getting_around: Sayulita is a small walkable town. Golf carts and ATVs can be rented for exploring nearby beaches. Buses and colectivos connect to Puerto Vallarta and surrounding towns along the Riviera Nayarit.
